about: Quality trend for the Grant Opportunity Analyser, one entry per fortnightly review cycle. Maintained by the grant-analyzer-health-check skill; seeded from stored eval runs so cycle one has a baseline to move against. Figures are defined in quality.py and judged against launch plan section 9a. Convergence is a diagnostic of retrieval quality, never a target: never propose caching or pinning results to raise it.

proposals_open.summary: Make each cycle's measurements survive the session that took them
proposals_open.solution: GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/quality-snapshot.yml) snapshots /admin/quality.json and /health?deep=1 daily at 07:00 UTC and commits reports/snapshots/quality-YYYY-MM-DD.json. The review reads a committed file: no network, no token, no secret in any prompt. Read path is snapshots.py + eval/read_snapshots.py, covered by tests/test_snapshots.py.

snapshot_health.gap_cause: No pipeline gap. The GitHub Actions workflow committed reports/snapshots/quality-YYYY-MM-DD.json every day from 29 Aug through 16 Sep. The local grant-analyzer working copy had not run git pull since ~28 Aug, so review sessions reading the local folder saw stale data.
